information:
Dette vil være den første konkurrence i Aarhus området efter mere end 6 år! Vi håber på, at se mange af jer til stede. Der er mulighed for gratis overnatning i lokalet. Læs mere på [denne fane](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AarhusSpring2019#8436-accommodation) om dette.
______
This will be the first competition in the Aarhus area after more than 6 years! We hope to see a lot of you present. There is the option of free accommodation at the venue. Please read more on [this tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AarhusSpring2019#8436-accommodation) about this.
